ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Autonomous equipment can drive straight rows, but operators still decide where to adjust settings and how to judge quality.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 65,200 agricultural equipment operators employed in 2024, rising to a projected 70,300 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 5,100 jobs and about 10,500 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $42,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace agricultural equipment operators, but it will reduce driving tasks. Autonomous operation and variable-rate applications accelerate routine work, shifting the job from steering toward field judgment, implement adjustment, and quality control. People who only steer face pressure, while operators who assess conditions and adjust implements become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Field judgment: people assess the terrain.
Implement adjustment: people provide hands-on feel.
Quality control: people provide the trained eye.
Emergency response: people make tradeoffs.
Farm-work scheduling: people provide experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure range. Driving and spraying accelerate, while human judgment and adjustment remain essential.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Steering actions are vulnerable, not field judgment. Operators who assess conditions and adjust implements become scarcer as farms scale. Those who only steer face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin with agricultural machinery and develop judgment and implement-adjustment skills. Pure driving is shrinking in the AI era, so build field capability early.
Progress from driving toward judgment and implement adjustment, and learn autonomous operating systems.
Emphasize licenses and equipment types, and identify the crops you worked with.
Do not hire based only on driving ability. Evaluate terrain judgment. Core operators deserve responsibility for large fields.

ai_s7_trends: Autonomous operation becomes widespread.
Demand grows with farm scale.
People with sound judgment are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自驾能跑直线，但哪块该调、怎么看质量，还是操作员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年农业操作员在岗约 6.52 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 7.03 万人，净增约 0.51 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.05 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.26 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代农业设备操作员，但会压缩行驶环节。自动驾驶与变量作业把常规提速，工作从「握方向盘」挪向「现场判断、农具调整、质量把控」。真正被挤掉的是只握方向盘的人，会判断会调具的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场判断：地形靠人。
农具调整：手感靠人。
质量把控：眼力靠人。
应急处置：取舍靠人。
农时安排：经验靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——行驶与喷洒被加速，但判断与调整还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「握方向盘」动作，不是「现场判断」的岗位。会判断会调具的人，反而随规模化更稀缺。怕的是只会握方向盘。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 农机起步多练判断与调具，AI 时代纯驾驶在缩，早点练现场。
从「驾驶」升级成「判断 + 调具」，学自驾系统。
突出证书与机种，写清跟过哪些作物。
选人别只看会开，要看会不会判断地形。骨干值得给大田。

ai_s7_trends: 自驾普及。
规模化需求增。
会判断的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Search tools can find literature, but teachers still decide how to interpret evidence, teach courses, and guide students.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 6,500 postsecondary teachers in this field were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 6,700 by 2034, a net gain of about 200 jobs, with roughly 500 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $95,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary teachers, but it will reduce routine lesson preparation. Literature and presentation tools speed up research and lecture-note drafting. Teachers can shift from preparing standard courses toward leading fieldwork, conducting research, guiding critical thinking, and reviewing papers. Instructors who only read slides face pressure, while strong academic mentors become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automated test assembly from question banks
ai_s3_list: Field judgment: people interpret the evidence.
Academic guidance: people develop critical thinking.
Thesis supervision: people set direction.
Value tradeoffs: people determine the position.
Teacher-student interaction: people inspire inquiry.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places this career in the moderate AI exposure range. Tools accelerate standard lesson preparation, but fieldwork and research still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces the task of reading standard slides, not the role of academic mentor. Teachers with field experience and strong mentoring skills become more scarce as tools improve efficiency. Instructors who only prepare standard lessons face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in the humanities and practice research and fieldwork. Routine lesson preparation is shrinking in the AI era, so develop mentoring skills early.
Move beyond lecturing toward leading research and applying for projects. Strengthen academic writing and pursue responsibility for a subject area.
Highlight research results and field experience. State clearly which sites you have studied.
Do not assess candidates by degrees alone. Evaluate whether they can mentor students. Teachers who guide critical thinking are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Literature tools are widespread, reducing lesson-preparation work.
Digital archeology creates opportunities.
Professionals who guide others effectively are in greater demand.

career_ai_description_block.heading: Search tools can find literature, but teachers still decide how to interpret evidence, teach courses, and guide students.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校教师，但会压缩标准备课。文献与课件工具把资料检索和讲义生成提速，教师从「备标准课」挪向「带田野、做研究、引导思辨、改论文」。真正被挤掉的是只念 PPT 的人，有学术引导力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 田野判断：材料靠人释。
学术引导：思辨靠人带。
论文指导：方向靠人定。
价值权衡：立场靠人。
师生互动：启发靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——标准备课被加速，但田野与研究还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「念标准 PPT」动作，不是「学术引导」的岗位。有田野和引导力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做标准备课的人。

从「讲课」升级成「带研究 + 申项目」，学写作，争取方向负责。

选人别只看学历，要看会不会带人。能引导思辨的人值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 文献工具普及，备课缩。
数字考古带来机会。
会引导的人更抢手。

Employment is projected to reach 17,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,500 jobs, with roughly 700 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $92,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace audiologists, but it will assist hearing-test analysis and automated fitting. Systems can set initial parameters, shifting audiologists from adjusting equipment toward diagnosis and rehabilitation. Pure equipment operation faces pressure, while professionals who can diagnose conditions and teach patients become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Diagnostic judgment: people interpret the evidence.
Fitting decisions: people apply experience.
Rehabilitation communication: people provide empathy.
Teaching older adults: people provide patience.
Follow-up oversight: people accept responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10, low-moderate, reflects limited exposure in this rehabilitation profession. Technology accelerates operational tasks, while diagnosis and rehabilitation remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure means limited occupational risk. Pure equipment operation faces replacement, not diagnosis and rehabilitation roles. Professionals who can diagnose conditions and teach older adults become scarcer as technology advances. Roles limited to pressing buttons face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in audiology, then develop equipment and communication skills.
Advance from device fitting to diagnosis + rehabilitation, and build a case portfolio.
Emphasize hearing tests and rehabilitation, and identify the patient populations you have served.
Assess patience and attention to detail when hiring. Professionals who can teach older adults are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Automated fitting is spreading.
Remote adjustment is entering practice.
Rehabilitation still depends on people.

body: Audiologists assess hearing loss, fit hearing aids, program implant devices, provide auditory rehabilitation and counseling, and patiently teach older adults and families to use equipment. Their work helps people hear again and connects healthcare with daily life.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代听力师，但会辅助测听分析与自动验配。系统初调参数，听力师从「调设备」转向「判诊断、做康复」。真正被挤掉的是纯操作，会诊断会教的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 诊断判断：脑子靠人。
验配拿捏：经验靠人。
康复沟通：共情靠人。
老人教学：耐心靠人。
随访把关：责任靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 2/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的康复区——操作被加速，但诊断与康复仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光几乎零风险：被替代的是「纯操作」，不是「诊断康复」的岗位。会诊断、会教老人的人，反而随技术更稀缺。怕的是只会按按钮的人。

从验配升级成诊断 + 康复，攒病例。

远程调试上岗。
康复仍靠人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can help find faults, but aviation inspectors must still accept responsibility for the signature that determines whether an aircraft is released.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 25,700 aviation inspectors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 26,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with approximately 2,500 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $85,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace aviation inspectors, but it will change their daily work. Inspectors once spent half their time searching paper work cards, copying records, and checking lists. Digital systems are taking over those tasks. The remaining work involves verifying data, inspecting aircraft in person, and exercising judgment. AI can provide leads, but it cannot sign the release.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted interpretation of nondestructive testing images from X-ray, ultrasound, and eddy-current systems, with suspected defects flagged for human review
Large-scale analysis of flight data and maintenance records to predict component failure windows
Automated clustering of fleet fault patterns to help determine whether similar problems require grounding and investigation
Large-model search across regulations and manuals to locate applicable airworthiness requirements within seconds
ai_s2_auto: Digital entry, retrieval, and archiving of maintenance records and work cards
Automated comparison of airworthiness directives with flags for items approaching their due dates
Item-by-item checklist completion and review reminders
Automated drafting and formatting of inspection reports
ai_s3_list: On-site visual and tactile judgment: sensors cannot replace the human ability to feel looseness or see subtle cracks.
Regulatory interpretation and release discretion: people must decide how the same requirement applies across different aircraft types and operating conditions.
Accident investigation and responsibility determination: reconstructing the causal chain and assigning responsibility requires procedural fairness that machines cannot provide.
Cross-functional communication: people translate technical conclusions for maintenance crews, dispatchers, regulators, and passenger representatives.
Building a safety culture: encouraging frontline staff to report problems instead of concealing them is a management challenge, not an algorithmic one.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, means about half of this career's tasks are highly rules-based. AI can quickly take over records, checklists, and reports.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Aviation inspection is a field where rules are clear and responsibility is substantial. AI helps inspectors see more and work faster, but people still accept release responsibility and answer questions during investigations. AI amplifies efficiency in this career instead of replacing the role.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study aviation maintenance or aircraft maintenance engineering, prioritize licensing coursework and English, and consider a school with industry partnership programs. In the AI era, the valuable combination is the ability to understand systems and make sound hands-on judgments.

Proactively learn data analysis and nondestructive testing instead of stopping at record review. Future release inspectors need to use AI-assisted interpretation while remaining willing to reject a system's conclusion.

Frontline aircraft maintenance experience is a firm entry requirement, so complete the necessary licenses and service years first. In career-transition interviews, discuss release disagreements you resolved independently and work you stopped, because those examples matter more than tools.

When hiring inspectors, look beyond certificates to their record of judgment, including disputed items they handled and corrective recommendations they wrote. The competency model should shift from checking compliance to making decisions, accepting responsibility, and understanding data.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Digital work cards, task dispatch, and auditable records
ai_s6_tools.定位: Maintenance work orders and records management

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Ultrasonic and eddy-current testing with AI-assisted interpretation of defect images
Failure prediction, trend analysis, and exceedance alerts
Large-model semantic search to quickly locate applicable provisions
Item-by-item checks, photographic evidence, and automated report generation
Photography of elevated areas and stitched-image comparison
Recommend inspection windows based on sensor data
Event reporting, statistical analysis, and closed-loop tracking

ai_s7_trends: As predictive maintenance becomes widespread, inspection is shifting from scheduled disassembly to condition-based maintenance, and inspectors spend more time reviewing data.
Drones and robots inspect aircraft exteriors, fuel tanks, and other hazardous areas, reducing the need for inspectors to climb and enter confined spaces.
As airworthiness oversight becomes digital, inspectors increasingly combine data review with on-site sampling. Their release signatures become even more valuable.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮忙找毛病，但「放不放行」这个签字，暂时还得检查员来担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年航空检查员在岗约 2.57 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.61 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.25 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.57 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代航空检查员，但会改变他们每天干什么。以前检查员一半时间在翻纸质工卡、抄记录、对清单，这些活儿正被数字化系统吃掉。剩下的工作是核数据、看现场、做判断——AI 能给线索，给不了签字。
ai_s2_accel: 无损检测图像（X 光、超声、涡流）的 AI 辅助判读，标出疑似缺陷供人复核
飞行数据与维护记录的大数据分析，提前预测部件故障窗口
机队故障模式的自动聚类，帮助判断同类问题是否要停飞排查
法规条款与手册的大模型检索，秒级定位相关适航要求
ai_s2_auto: 维修记录与工卡的电子化录入、检索与归档
适航指令的比对核对，系统自动标出到期项
检查清单的逐项勾选与复查提示
检查报告初稿的自动生成与格式整理
ai_s3_list: 现场目视与触觉判断：摸出来的松动、看出来的裂纹，传感器替代不了手感。
法规解释与放行裁量：同一句话在不同机型、不同工况下怎么执行，需要人来拿主意。
事故调查与责任判定：还原原因链、分清谁的责任，是机器给不了的程序正义。
跨角色沟通：把技术结论翻译给机务、签派、监管和乘客代表，靠的是人。
安全文化的建设：让一线愿意把问题报出来，而不是藏着，这是管理课题不是算法课题。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半的任务高度规则化——记录、清单、报告，AI 一进来就接管了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。航空检查员恰恰是「规则越清晰、责任越重大」的典型：AI 帮你看得更多、更快，最终承担放行责任和调查质询的还是人。这个职业被 AI 放大的是效率，不是被替代。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 报航空维修、飞行器维修工程相关专业，读书期间把执照课程和英语抓牢，最好去有校企合作订单班的院校。AI 时代这行更值钱的是「能看懂系统、还能上手判断」的复合能力。
主动学数据分析和无损检测，别满足于「会查记录」。会用 AI 辅助判读、敢对系统的结论说「不」，才是未来放行岗的竞争力。
机务维修背景是硬门槛，先补齐执照和一线年限。转行面试时，多讲你独立判断过哪些放行分歧、叫停过哪些施工，比讲工具更重要。
招检查员别只看证书，要看判断记录——他处理过多少分歧件、写过多少整改意见。能力模型要从「会核对」转向「敢判断、能担责、懂数据」。

超声/涡流检测，AI 辅助判读缺陷图像
故障预测、趋势分析、超限告警
ai_s6_tools.工具: 飞行数据记录分析平台

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 大模型语义检索，快速定位适用条款
逐项打勾、拍照留证、自动生成报告
高空部位拍照、影像拼接比对
基于传感器数据推荐检查窗口
事件上报、统计分析、闭环跟踪

ai_s7_trends: 预测性维护普及后，检查从「按周期拆检」转向「按数据状态检修」，检查员更多时间在审数据。
无人机与机器人在机身外观、油箱等危险区域巡检，把检查员从登高爬低里解放出来。
适航监管数字化，检查员逐步转型为「数据审核 + 现场抽验」双轨工作者，签字含金量反而更高。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate smart-contract drafts, but engineers still choose the consensus mechanism, identify reentrancy vulnerabilities, and define the compliance approach.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 472,000 blockchain engineers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 510,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 38,500 jobs, with approximately 31,300 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $109,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Blockchain Engineers, but it will reduce the value of template-based development. AI accelerates contract drafts and scaffolding, shifting engineers from boilerplate toward architecture, security audits, cross-chain systems, and compliance. People who only apply templates without understanding the underlying systems face displacement.
ai_s3_list: Architectural judgment: people choose the consensus mechanism.
Security audits: people identify vulnerabilities.
Cross-chain design: people make the tradeoffs.
Compliance alignment: people define the boundaries.
Accountable: people accept responsibility when something goes wrong.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10 places Blockchain Engineers in the relatively high AI-exposure range. AI accelerates routine contracts and scaffolding, while security and architecture remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively high exposure does not mean high risk. Template-based development is being replaced, not security auditing and architecture design. People who only apply templates without understanding the underlying systems face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a strong computer-science foundation and study cryptography and smart contracts early. Pure template application is shrinking in the AI era.
Advance from writing contracts to security and architecture. Learn auditing and formal verification.
Emphasize security and on-chain projects, and identify the mainnets you have supported.
Assess security and systems fundamentals instead of only which SDKs a candidate can integrate.

ai_s7_trends: Template-based development shrinks.
Demand for security audits rises.
Cross-chain and compliance work creates more opportunities.

body: Blockchain Engineers design, develop, and maintain blockchain systems and smart contracts. They work with consensus, keys, nodes, and on-chain interactions to protect the security, correctness, and performance of decentralized applications.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate smart-contract drafts, but engineers still choose the consensus mechanism, identify reentrancy vulnerabilities, and define the compliance approach.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能生成合约草稿，但哪套共识该选、怎么审出重入漏洞、合规怎么谈，还是工程师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年区块链工程师在岗约 47.20 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 51.05 万人，净增约 3.85 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.90 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代区块链工程师，但会压低模板化开发。AI 把合约草稿与脚手架提速，工程师从「写样板」挪向「架构、安全审计、跨链与合规」。真正被挤的是只套模板、不懂底层的人。
ai_s3_list: 架构判断：共识靠人定。
安全审计：漏洞靠人找。
跨链设计：权衡靠人。
合规对齐：边界靠人。
责任担当：出事靠人扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明区块链工程师处于高 AI 曝光区——常规合约与脚手架被加速，但安全与架构还留人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是模板化开发，不是安全审计与架构设计。怕的是只套模板、不懂底层的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 计算机底子打牢，早学密码学与合约，AI 时代纯套模板在缩。
从「写合约」升级成「做安全 + 架构」，学审计与形式化验证。
突出安全与链上项目，写明扛过哪些主网。
选人看安全与底层功力，别只看会接哪个 SDK。

ai_s7_trends: 模板化开发缩。
安全审计需求升。
跨链与合规机会多。

body: 区块链工程师设计、开发与维护区块链系统与智能合约，处理共识、密钥、节点与链上交互，保障去中心化应用的安全、正确与性能。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Tools can run samples and produce spectra automatically, but Chemists still decide which path is worth testing, how to interpret unusual peaks, and whether results meet compliance requirements.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 86,800 Chemists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 91,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,200 jobs, with about 6,300 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $84,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Chemists, but it will accelerate routine experiments. Automated synthesis and data analysis speed up repetitive operations, shifting Chemists from running samples toward experimental design, mechanism analysis, formulation innovation, and compliance interpretation. People who only repeat procedures face pressure; those who design experiments and understand mechanisms become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Experimental design: people develop the approach.
Mechanism analysis: people identify root causes.
Formulation innovation: people provide insight.
Compliance interpretation: people define the boundaries.
Anomaly investigation: people provide persistence.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this R&D career in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems accelerate routine analysis, but people retain a central role in design and mechanism analysis.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk: repetitive sample runs are being replaced, not experimental design roles. Chemists who design experiments and understand mechanisms become scarcer as productivity rises. The greatest pressure falls on people limited to following SOPs.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Starting with a bachelor's degree in chemistry, practice experimental design extensively. Routine sample runs are shrinking in the AI era, so learn instruments and mechanisms early.
Move from conducting experiments to designing experiments + explaining mechanisms. Learn data tools and work toward project leadership.
Highlight projects and spectrum-analysis skills, and specify the research directions you have supported. Employers value practical outcomes and compliance awareness.
Do not hire on education alone; assess experimental design ability. People who can explain mechanisms deserve stronger compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Automated experiments are spreading, reducing routine analysis.
Green chemistry and materials innovation create opportunities.
Chemists who design experiments and understand mechanisms are in greater demand.

body: Chemists design and conduct chemical experiments, analyze substance composition and reaction mechanisms, develop formulations and processes, and use instruments and data to ensure product purity and compliance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Tools can run samples and produce spectra automatically, but Chemists still decide which path is worth testing, how to interpret unusual peaks, and whether results meet compliance requirements.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 工具能自动跑样出谱，但哪条路值得试、异常峰怎么解、合规怎么判，还是化学家定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年化学家在岗约 8.68 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.10 万人，净增约 0.42 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.63 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.41 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代化学家，但会加速常规实验。自动化合成与数据分析把重复操作提速，化学家从「跑样」挪向「实验设计、机理判断、配方创新、合规解读」。真正被挤掉的是只做重复操作的人，会设计懂机理的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 实验设计：思路靠人。
机理判断：根因靠人。
配方创新：洞察靠人。
合规解读：边界靠人。
异常追因：耐心靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的研发区——常规分析被系统加速，但设计与机理还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「重复跑样」动作，不是「实验设计」的岗位。会设计懂机理的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会按 SOP 操作的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 化学本科起步多练实验设计，AI 时代纯跑样在缩，早点学仪器和机理。
从「做实验」升级成「设实验 + 解机理」，学数据工具，争取管项目。
突出项目和谱图能力，写清跟过哪些方向。企业看重落地和合规。
选人别只看学历，要看会不会设计。能解机理的人，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 自动实验普及，常规分析缩。
绿色与材料创新带来机会。
会设计懂机理的化学家更抢手。

body: 化学家设计并进行化学实验，分析物质组成与反应机理，开发配方与工艺，并运用仪器与数据确保产物的纯度与合规。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Self-service ordering can place the order, but an attendant still clears and cleans the table after guests leave.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 527,400 Dining Room And Cafeteria Attendants And Bartender Helpers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 560,600 by 2034. That represents about 33,200 additional jobs and roughly 99,600 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $32,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Dining Room And Cafeteria Attendants And Bartender Helpers, but automation will handle parts of ordering and clearing. Self-service kiosks, tray-return systems, and centralized dishwashing reduce repetitive work. Attendants shift toward table setup, rapid turnover, cross-station assistance, and sanitation. Workers who cover several stations offer more value than those limited to clearing.
ai_s2_auto: Automated self-service ordering and queue notifications
ai_s3_list: Table setup and turnover: people control the pace.
Cross-station assistance: people connect front- and back-of-house work.
Bar supply delivery: people judge the timing.
Sanitation: people clean overlooked areas.
Customer complaints: people stabilize the situation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places Dining Room And Cafeteria Attendants And Bartender Helpers in the relatively low AI exposure range. Systems automate ordering and tray return, while people remain necessary for table setup and turnover.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not eliminate job risk. Automation replaces isolated plate-carrying and table-clearing tasks, not cross-station assistance. Fast workers who can set tables, assist the bar, and turn tables become more valuable. Roles limited to clearing face greater pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This occupation has a low entry threshold and quick onboarding, but do not stop at clearing tables. Learn table setup and bar assistance early, then progress toward Waiters And Waitresses roles.
Develop from table clearing into cross-station assistance. Learn table setup and basic bar work, then seek Waiters And Waitresses or host roles.
Emphasize reliability and cross-station experience. State table-turnover performance and sanitation standards clearly. Food-service employers value steady, fast workers.
Do not hire only on low hourly cost. Test speed, coordination, and awareness. Workers who cover multiple stations merit stronger shift premiums.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service systems and tray-return robots expand, reducing roles limited to table clearing.
Food-service helpers who cover multiple stations receive greater attention.
Demand from institutional and chain food service remains stable.

body: Dining Room And Cafeteria Attendants And Bartender Helpers set tables, clear and clean dining areas, replenish utensils and supplies, and prepare items for bartenders. Their work keeps dining rooms and bars operating smoothly.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Self-service ordering can place the order, but an attendant still clears and cleans the table after guests leave.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自助点餐把单下了，但那桌客人吃完留下的狼藉，还是帮工去收去擦。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年餐厅与食堂服务员帮工在岗约 52.74 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 56.06 万人，净增约 3.32 万个岗位，年均产生约 9.96 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.27 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代餐饮帮工，但会接管点单与收餐的部分环节。自助点餐、收餐机器人和中央洗碗把重复动作吃掉，帮工从「端盘收碗」挪向「摆台翻台、多岗协助、卫生保障」。真正被挤掉的是只做单一收餐的人，能兼顾多岗的更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 智能备料与物料库存提醒
吧台杯具清洗的半自动
排班与高峰预测的智能优化
ai_s2_auto: 自助点餐与排队叫号的自动化
收餐传送与餐盘回流的自动化
中央洗碗与餐具清洁的自动化
用餐数据与翻台率的自动统计
ai_s3_list: 摆台翻台：节奏靠人控。
多岗协助：前后场靠人接。
吧台递料：时机靠人卡。
卫生保障：死角靠人清。
客诉兜底：现场靠人稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光的现场服务区——点单收餐被系统接管，但摆台翻台留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「端盘收碗」动作，不是「多岗协助」的岗位。能兼顾摆台吧台、翻台快的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只做单一收餐的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这行门槛低、能快速上岗，但别只收餐。早点练摆台和吧台辅助，往服务员走。
从「收餐」升级成「多岗协助」，学摆台和吧台基础，争取转服务员或领位。
突出勤快和多岗经验，写清翻台速度和卫生标准。餐饮招聘看重稳和快。
招人别只看便宜，要看手脚麻不利索。能兼顾多岗的，值得给高工时补贴。

ai_s7_trends: 自助与收餐机器人渗透，纯收餐缩。
多岗协助型帮工更受重视。
团餐与连锁需求稳。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Software can calculate cutting layouts, but installers still use their hands and eyes to identify crooked walls, repair joints, and judge flatness.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 103,100 Drywall And Ceiling Tile Installers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 107,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,300 jobs, with about 7,700 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $58,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace these workers, but it will shorten material-cutting time. Layout and measurement software accelerates routine cuts. Workers shift from cutting without plans toward irregular-shape adjustments, on-site leveling, and quality control. Standard-panel-only roles face the most pressure, while workers who can apply joint compound and repair older buildings become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Irregular-shape adjustments: require people on site.
Joint-compound leveling: depends on human touch.
Older-building repairs: depend on experience.
Quality control: people provide the trained eye.
Operational coordination: people control the pace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation in the relatively low AI exposure range. Core tasks involve carrying panels and leveling surfaces on site. Systems cannot readily take over, though cutting-layout software is spreading.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not eliminate risk. Standard cutting tasks face replacement, while joint-compound finishing and corrective work remain. Workers who level surfaces and handle irregular shapes become scarcer as construction industrializes.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Learn basic layout and joint-compound application. Pure panel-carrying roles are shrinking, so build leveling and irregular-shape skills early.
Advance from installation into joint-compound finishing and quality control, then work toward crew leadership.
Highlight trade experience and physical resilience. Interior-construction crews value reliability and careful work.
Do not hire for physical strength alone. Assess leveling, self-inspection, and crew-leadership skills to retain high-performing workers.

ai_s7_trends: Prefabrication moves work off site and reduces on-site tasks.
Leveling skills are becoming more valuable.
Workers who handle irregular shapes are in greater demand.

body: Drywall And Ceiling Tile Installers install and fasten drywall, ceiling panels, and framing. They fill joints, apply joint compound, and sand surfaces until walls and ceilings are flat enough for decoration.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Software can calculate cutting layouts, but installers still use their hands and eyes to identify crooked walls, repair joints, and judge flatness.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会压缩下料时间。排版与测量软件把常规裁切提速，人从「盲裁」挪向「异形修整、现场找平、质量把控」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准板的，会刮平、能处理老房的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 异形修整：现场靠人。
刮腻找平：手感靠人。
老房处理：经验靠人。
质量把控：眼力靠人。
协同衔接：节奏靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光——核心是扛板与刮平的现场手艺，系统暂时难接手，但下料软件会慢慢渗透。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准下料」动作，不是「刮平修整」的岗位。会找平、能处理异形的人，反而随工业化更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学放线与刮腻基础，纯扛板在缩，早点练找平和异形。
从「安装」升级成「刮平 + 质量把控」，争取班组头。
突出工种经验和吃苦耐劳，装修队看重稳和细。
选人别只看体力，要看会不会找平和自检，能带工的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 装配式前移，现场缩。
找平手艺更被看重。
会异形的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can prepare a lesson in three minutes and grade half a class's assignments, but an elementary school teacher must still observe why a child is distracted today and whether a different explanation is needed.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,422,700 education teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 1,394,800 by 2034, a net loss of about 27,900 jobs, with about 91,000 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $62,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace elementary school teachers, but it will substantially reduce their desk workload. AI can accelerate lesson planning, question writing, grading, and learning analysis, shifting teachers' time from writing lesson plans and marking assignments to classroom organization, individual support, and family communication. The truly scarce skill is engaging a classroom of children with widely different personalities in every lesson.
ai_s2_accel: AI personalized-learning systems that assign questions by student level
Classroom interaction and game-based teaching tools
Speech recognition for reading practice and pronunciation correction
Intelligent analysis and early warnings from learning data
ai_s2_auto: Automatic generation of lesson plans and presentation materials
ai_s3_list: Classroom organization: only a teacher on site can manage dozens of children in different states at the same moment.
Face-to-face teaching relationships: eye contact, tone, praise, and correction depend on genuine human interaction that AI cannot provide.
Student observation and judgment: teachers are often the first to notice when something is wrong with a child.
Classroom management and conflict resolution: disputes among children require immediate mediation and practical human judgment.
Family communication: translate professional judgments into language families understand and trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate exposure because about half of this role involves desk work, including lesson planning, grading, question writing, and recordkeeping, which AI is well suited to accelerate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: The replacement risk remains limited because education is fundamentally human-to-human. As AI makes standardized instruction cheaper, individualized teaching and student development become more valuable. Repetitive desk work will shrink, but teaching children in a classroom will continue to require people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Teacher education remains worthwhile, but consider regional enrollment and public-school staffing conditions carefully. Build strong teaching fundamentals and learn to use AI tools for lesson planning and learning analysis. Teachers who combine traditional expertise with new technology will be the most competitive.

Let AI support lesson planning and grading, and invest the saved time in classroom teaching and individual guidance. Build a personal knowledge base for responding to different students; that experience cannot simply be taken over by AI.

If you have subject expertise, earn an elementary teaching credential and enter through substitute or contract work before pursuing a permanent public-school position. Career changers in the AI era need a combination of teaching knowledge, tool fluency, and commitment to student development.

When hiring elementary school teachers, assess classroom presence and commitment to student development, not only degrees and credentials. Providing AI tools that reduce desk workload is one of the most direct ways to improve teaching quality.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid generation of lesson plans and presentation materials
Questions matched to ability and progress tracking
Grade trends and early warnings for weak areas

ai_s7_trends: AI-supported lesson planning and grading become standard, significantly reducing teachers' desk time.
Personalized learning and differentiated instruction become practical, shifting teachers toward guidance and student development.
Changes in birth rates create regional differences in enrollment, while competition for excellent teachers becomes more intense.

body: Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education teach multiple subjects at the elementary level, organize classroom instruction and management, observe and support student development, and collaborate with families and colleagues.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能三分钟备好一节课、批完半班作业，但「这个孩子今天为什么走神、那句话要不要换个说法」，还得小学老师现场的观察。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教育教师在岗约 142.27 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 139.48 万人，岗位净减约 2.79 万个，年均产生约 9.10 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.23 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代小学教师，但会显著减轻案头负担。备课、出题、批改、学情分析都能交给 AI 提速，教师的时间从「写教案、改作业」挪向「课堂组织、个别辅导和家校沟通」。真正稀缺的，是面对几十个性格各异的孩子，把每一节课变成他们愿意参与的课堂的能力。
ai_s2_accel: AI 个性化学习系统按学生水平出题
课堂互动与游戏化教学工具
语音识别辅助朗读与发音纠正
学情数据的智能分析与预警
ai_s2_auto: 教案与课件的自动生成
家校通知与沟通消息的草拟
ai_s3_list: 课堂组织：几十个孩子同一时刻的不同状态，只有老师能现场拿捏。
面对面的教学关系：眼神、语气、夸奖和批评，AI 给不了真实互动。
学生观察与判断：哪个孩子今天不对劲，老师往往是第一个知道的。
班级管理与冲突处理：孩子之间的矛盾要现场调解，这是活的学问。
家校沟通：把专业判断翻译成家长听得懂、信得过的话。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半工作在案头——备课、批改、出题、记录，这些正是 AI 擅长加速的部分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低风险在于教育是「人对人」：AI 越强，标准化的「教」越便宜，因材施教和育人价值越高。被压缩的是重复性案头，而站在讲台上面对孩子的工作，始终需要人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 师范教育依然值得，但要想清楚地区生源和编制形势。把教学基本功练扎实，同时会用 AI 备课和学情分析工具，这类「传统功底 + 新技术」的教师最有竞争力。
把备课、批改交给 AI，把省下的时间花在课堂和个别辅导上。积累自己应对不同学生的经验库，这些是 AI 学不走的东西。
有学科背景就考教资，从代课、合同制岗位切入，先进教育圈子再寻求考编。AI 时代的转行教师要拿出「懂教学、会用工具、有育人热情」的组合。
招小学教师别只看学历和证书，要看课堂表现力和育人意愿。给教师配 AI 工具、降低案头负担，是提升教学质量最直接的手段。

ai_s7_trends: AI 备课与批改成为标配，教师的案头时间明显减少。
个性化学习与因材施教真正落地，教师角色转向引导与育人。
出生率变化导致区域生源分化，优质教师竞争反而更激烈。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Scheduling systems can calculate visitor traffic, but managers still decide when an event feels wrong and how to recover on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 43,200 Entertainment And Recreation Managers, Except Gambling were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 46,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,300 jobs, with about 5,500 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $77,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Entertainment And Recreation Managers, Except Gambling, but it will accelerate scheduling and ticketing. Traffic forecasts, automated staff schedules, and revenue dashboards speed up administrative work. Managers shift from building rosters toward experience design, site coordination, safety response, and vendor management. Roles limited to scheduling and reporting face pressure, while managers who can stabilize on-site operations become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use AI to optimize event schedules
ai_s2_auto: Forecast visitor traffic and automate staff scheduling
ai_s3_list: Experience design: people decide what atmosphere works.
Site coordination: people recover when unexpected events occur.
Safety response: people judge whether conditions on site are acceptable.
Vendor coordination: people negotiate competing interests.
Complaint resolution: people absorb and resolve emotional reactions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate exposure. Systems accelerate scheduling and ticketing, but people remain central to on-site operations and safety.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure points to stable demand for the role, not every task. Systems replace parts of scheduling and reporting, not on-site coordination. Managers who design strong experiences and take responsibility for safety become scarcer as operations improve. Roles limited to roster preparation face the most pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through a bachelor's degree in tourism or management and pursue internships at attractions. Pure scheduling work is contracting in the AI era, so develop site-operations and experience-design skills early.
Move beyond preparing schedules toward designing experiences and controlling site operations. Learn to use data dashboards and pursue responsibility for a region.
Highlight operations and visitor-traffic experience. State which projects you managed and at what scale. Venue owners value steady judgment and the ability to handle problems.
Do not screen candidates by education alone. Test whether they can control an active site. Managers who can protect safety during disruptions justify stronger compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Recovery in tourism and leisure increases demand.
Systems handle schedules while people design experiences.
Managers who control sites and handle incidents are in greater demand.

body: Entertainment And Recreation Managers, Except Gambling oversee daily operations at attractions, venues, and resorts. They schedule events, coordinate staff and vendors, protect safety and guest experience, and manage revenue and memberships.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 排期系统能帮你算人流，但哪场活动氛围不对、现场怎么救，还是经理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年休闲经理、博彩在岗约 4.32 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.65 万人，净增约 0.33 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.55 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.72 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代休闲经理，但会加速排期与票务。人流预测、自动排班和营收看板把事务提速，经理从「排表」挪向「体验设计、现场调度、安全处置、商户协调」。真正被挤掉的是纯排班与报表，有现场力能兜底的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 体验设计：氛围靠人定。
现场调度：突发靠人救。
安全处置：场面对不对靠人。
商户协调：利益靠人扯。
客诉兜底：情绪靠人接。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的运营区——排期票务被系统加速，但现场与安全还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着岗位稳：被替代的是「排班与报表」动作，不是「现场调度」的岗位。有体验脑、能兜底安全的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做排表的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 旅游或管理本科打底，在校多实习景区。AI 时代纯排班在缩，早点练现场和体验。
从「排表」升级成「做体验 + 控现场」，学数据看板，争取管区域。
突出运营与客流经验，写清管过哪些项目。业主看重稳和兜底。
选人别只看学历，要看会不会控场。能兜底安全的经理，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 文旅复苏推高需求。
系统替排期，人做体验。
能控场兜底的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the most efficient cutting plan, but someone must hold a panel steady and correctly when the carpenter starts the saw. That still depends on a helper's shoulders and hands.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 25,200 carpenter helpers in 2024, projected to rise to 26,400 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 1,200 jobs, with roughly 2,700 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $41,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace carpenter helpers, but it will take over material lists and cutting calculations. Carrying materials, holding panels, handing tools, and assisting carpenters are field-based physical and coordination tasks machines cannot soon replace.
ai_s2_accel: CNC saws reduce manual support during cutting
Laser measurement assists layout and positioning
AR drawing overlays assist installation positioning
ai_s2_auto: Automatic material lists and withdrawal records
ai_s3_list: Site coordination: understand which tool to hand over and which side to support from one movement.
Carrying and support technique: move panels without injuring the back and stabilize components.
Safety awareness: know where to stand when saws run and where to avoid during lifts.
Understanding drawings and processes: remember layout and cutting instruction and practice by hand.
Coordination with other trades: make room and assist plumbing, electrical, and masonry crews.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation in a low-moderate AI exposure range. Lists, layouts, and records form little of the role; most work is physical field coordination with limited direct AI replacement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure still brings change. AI and prefabrication reduce material-handling support, but worksites still need people to hold panels and hand materials. The real risk is remaining a helper without learning the trade. Advancing to carpenter and learning CNC cutting provide the path forward.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For students finishing middle school who want a trade, helper work is accessible. Do not remain a helper: learn carpentry within two years, earn skill credentials, and move toward finish carpentry or CNC cutting.

Set firm goals during helper work: learn layout and cutting within the first year and assemble independently within two years. Study drawings with the carpenter, learn CNC equipment, and advance quickly rather than exchanging youth for carrying wages.

Helper work offers career changers a fast view of construction, but requires a clear advancement plan. On a resume, name carpentry projects completed without safety incidents rather than claiming only that you work hard.
Assess safety habits before strength when hiring. Crews with mentors willing to teach drawings and cutting achieve better helper advancement and stability. Safety training must come first.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Power saws, planers, and nail guns
Standard parts made in factories and installed on site

ai_s7_trends: As prefabrication and factory production spread, on-site handling support declines and helper demand shifts toward installation and digital-tool coordination.
As CNC cutting spreads, helpers who learn equipment can bypass some physical labor and raise earnings.
Tighter worksite safety and credential requirements narrow opportunities for uncredentialed material-only helpers.

body: Helpers to Carpenters support carpenters by moving and handing over materials, stabilizing components during cutting or installation, cleaning work areas, and preparing measurement and cutting tasks.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate the most efficient cutting plan, but someone must hold a panel steady and correctly when the carpenter starts the saw. That still depends on a helper's shoulders and hands.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出最优下料方案，但师傅开锯时那块板得有人扶稳、扶对位置——这活还是帮工的肩膀和手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年帮工木工在岗约 2.52 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.64 万人，净增约 0.12 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.27 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.16 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代帮工木工，但会接管领料清单和排料计算。剩下的搬料、扶板、递工具、配合师傅，全是现场体力与配合，机器替不了，短期内也最稳当。
ai_s2_accel: 数控锯自动下料减少人工扶持
激光测量辅助放线定位
预制件工厂化减少现场搬运
AR 图纸叠加辅助安装定位
ai_s2_auto: 材料清单与领料记录自动生成
下料排版由软件自动计算
工具出入库系统化管理
ai_s3_list: 现场配合：师傅一个动作你就知道要递什么、扶哪边。
搬运与扶持手法：板材怎么扛不闪腰、构件怎么扶最稳当。
安全意识：电锯响起来该站哪、吊装时该躲哪，命是自己的。
领会图纸与工序：师傅教的放线、下料，得靠脑子记、手上练。
与各工种的衔接：给水电、瓦工让路、搭手，是现场协作的学问。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的清单、排料、记录比重很低——绝大部分工作在现场体力与配合上，AI 直接替代的空间很小。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于不变。AI 和预制化正在减少「搬运配合」类岗位，但工地永远需要有人扶板、递料。真正的风险不是 AI，是「一直当帮工不学手艺」——转正木工、学会数控下料，才是出路。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 初中毕业想学门手艺，帮工是低门槛起点。但别让孩子停在帮工——两年内必须跟师傅学成木工，再考技能证书，往细木工或数控下料方向走。
帮工期间把目标定死：一年内会放线下料，两年内独立拼装。主动跟师傅学识图，学用数控设备，尽快转正，别拿青春换搬运费。
想转行进工地，帮工是快速了解行业的入口，但要有清晰的转正计划。简历里写「配合师傅完成XX项目木作、无安全事故」，比一句能吃苦有用。
招帮工先看安全习惯再看力气。愿意带人、教识图下料的师傅队伍，帮工转正率高，队伍稳定性也高；安全培训必须做在前面。

ai_s7_trends: 预制化与工厂化施工普及，现场搬运配合类岗位减少，帮工需求向「会安装、会配合数字化工具」转移。
数控下料普及，帮工若学会操作数控设备，能直接跨过部分体力活、收入上台阶。
工地安全与持证要求趋严，无证纯搬料的帮工空间收窄。

body: 帮工木工（Helpers—Carpenters）是木工的辅助工种，负责搬运与传递材料、扶持被切割或安装的构件、清理作业面，并协助木工师傅完成测量、下料。
