ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the probability of flooding in seconds and automatically organize data, but the judgment of "whether this rain will cause a disaster and whether the monitoring data is trustworthy" still depends on people who understand water.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 6,300 hydrologists employed in 2024, projected to remain at about 6,300 in 2034, a net change of 0 jobs, with roughly 500 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $92,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace hydrologists, but it will restructure the way they work: data cleaning, model calibration, and first draft reports are being greatly accelerated by AI. Machine learning and data assimilation make forecasts more accurate; however, the design of monitoring station networks, judgment of the credibility of results, on-site data verification, and flood control decision-making recommendations still require the professional experience of hydrologists.
ai_s2_accel: Remote sensing and drone monitoring of hydrological elements
ai_s2_auto: Automatic cleaning and sorting of monitoring data
Reports and charts are automatically generated
Real-time processing of flow and water level data
ai_s3_list: Monitoring design: The scientific nature of station network layout.
Interpretation of results: Turn model output into judgment.
Field experience: data anomalies and field verification.
Decision support: Useful suggestions for flood control departments.
Professional judgment: Scenario analysis under climate change.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 illustrates that hydrologists are a "medium to high exposure" earth science position: data processing and model calculations are being largely taken over by AI, but monitoring design, result interpretation, on-site verification and decision-making support still require professionals, and the position is being upgraded to one that can judge and make decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium and high exposure means don’t just be a “model runner”: focus on monitoring design, field verification and decision support. AI will help you calculate, and you are responsible for “whether the calculation is correct and how to use it” - the person who makes the final decision in flood prevention decisions will always need people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For those majoring in hydrology, water resources, and hydraulic engineering, a bachelor's degree is not enough, and a master's degree is the mainstream. During college, practice programming (Python), GIS, and field internships, don't just learn theory.

Specialize in flood forecasting, groundwater simulation, and urban flooding, and learn machine learning and digital twin tools; retain your field experience. "Understanding the field" is a rare commodity in the AI ​​era.

Water conservancy, geography, and environmental backgrounds can be transferred to hydrology: hydrology modeling and programming, with an emphasis on field data experience; the interview emphasizes mathematical foundation and flood control project experience.

The hydrology team needs an "AI + expert" combination: use AI to process data and modeling, and put experts in monitoring design and decision support; give young employees opportunities to work in the field, and don't let them only run models.

ai_s7_trends: Climate change drives demand for flood forecasting and urban waterlogging and drought assessment.
AI and digital twins accelerate hydrological modeling and improve forecast accuracy.
Hydrologists move from running models to monitoring design and decision support.

body: Hydrologists study the distribution, movement and quality of surface water and groundwater, and are responsible for hydrological monitoring, runoff and flood analysis, water resources evaluation, and water quality research, providing scientific basis for flood prevention and drought relief, water resources planning, and environmental protection.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate the probability of flooding in seconds and automatically organize data, but the judgment of "whether this rain will cause a disaster and whether the monitoring data is trustworthy" still depends on people who understand water.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能秒级跑出洪水概率、自动整理数据，但「这场雨到底会不会成灾、监测数据可不可信」的判断，还得靠懂水的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年水文学家在岗约 0.63 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.63 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.05 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.21 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代水文学家，但会重构工作方式：数据清洗、模型标定、报告初稿这些环节正被 AI 大幅加速，机器学习和数据同化让预报更准；而监测站网设计、结果的可信度判断、现场数据核查和防汛决策建议，仍需水文学家的专业经验来兜底。
ai_s2_accel: 数据同化提升模型精度
遥感与无人机监测水文要素
ai_s2_auto: 监测数据自动清洗整理
流量水位数据实时处理
ai_s3_list: 监测设计：站网布设的科学性。
结果解读：把模型输出变成判断。
现场经验：数据异常与野外核查。
决策支撑：给防汛部门可用的建议。
专业判断：气候变化下的情景分析。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明水文学家是「中高曝光」的地球科学岗位：数据整理和模型运算正被 AI 大幅接管，但监测设计、结果解读、现场核查和决策支撑仍需专业的人，岗位向「会判断、能决策」升级。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着别只当「跑模型的」：把精力放在监测设计、野外核查和决策支撑上，AI 帮你算，你负责「算得对不对、怎么用」——防汛决策里那个拍板的人，永远需要人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学水文水资源、水利工程专业，本科不够用，硕士是主流；大学期间把编程（Python）、GIS 和野外实习都练起来，别只学理论。
往洪水预报、地下水模拟、城市内涝方向专精，学机器学习和数字孪生工具；把野外经验保持住，AI 时代「懂现场」是稀缺品。
水利、地理、环境背景可转水文：补水文模型和编程，重点是野外数据经验；面试时强调数理基础和防汛项目经历。
水文团队要「AI + 专家」搭配：用 AI 处理数据和建模，把专家放到监测设计和决策支撑上；给年轻员工野外轮岗机会，别让他们只会跑模型。

ai_s7_trends: 气候变化带动洪水预报、城市内涝与干旱评估需求。
AI 与数字孪生加速水文建模，预报精度提升。
水文学家从跑模型转向监测设计与决策支撑。

body: 水文学家研究地表水与地下水的分布、运动与质量，负责水文监测、径流与洪水分析、水资源评价、水质研究，为防汛抗旱、水资源规划与环境保护提供科学依据。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能秒级跑出洪水概率、自动整理数据，但「这场雨到底会不会成灾、监测数据可不可信」的判断，还得靠懂水的人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI video can monitor an entire store and data analytics can identify every vulnerability, but deciding whether to stop someone and how to intervene without causing harm still requires human judgment in the moment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,333,700 loss prevention managers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 1,393,500 by 2034. That represents roughly 59,800 additional jobs and about 106,700 openings per year, with median annual pay of approximately $136,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace loss prevention managers, but it will reshape frontline execution. AI video surveillance, anomalous-transaction detection, and inventory-shrinkage analytics are replacing manual screen monitoring and retrospective account checks, shifting managers from watching cameras to setting strategy. The truly scarce capabilities are classifying incidents, handling on-site conflict, and driving process corrections.
ai_s2_accel: Wider adoption of RFID merchandise tracking
AI identification of repeat offenders and organized refund-fraud groups
Cloud alerts integrated with anti-theft devices
ai_s2_auto: AI video detection of anomalous behavior
Alerts for anomalous transactions, returns, and exchanges
ai_s3_list: On-site judgment: whether to stop someone and how to intervene.
Incident classification: distinguishing internal theft from negligence and judging severity.
Communication judgment: navigating conversations with employees, police, and customers.
Process correction: closing vulnerabilities through policies and procedures.
Cost tradeoffs: balancing loss-prevention investment against returns.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score means loss prevention is an operational role with moderate AI exposure. AI can take over surveillance analysis, data analysis, and report generation, reducing frontline loss-prevention positions. Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk: AI cannot replace incident classification, on-site response, or policy correction, so managers shift from watching cameras to setting strategy and leading people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure calls for active development. Become proficient with AI video and data-analysis tools so systems identify anomalies while you focus on incident handling and process correction. Loss prevention managers who understand data and lead teams become increasingly sought after in retail and e-commerce warehousing.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For a career in loss prevention management, study retail management, logistics, or data analysis and add basic security and legal knowledge. Start in store operations or as a loss prevention specialist at a retailer, build two years of on-site experience, then move into management.

Learn AI video surveillance and data analysis, then progress toward regional loss prevention or headquarters risk control. Study labor law and evidence handling to manage internal-theft cases professionally and expand advancement opportunities.

People with retail operations, security management, or logistics backgrounds have an advantage when moving into loss prevention. In interviews, emphasize specific shrinkage cases you handled and their data instead of making vague claims about responsibility.

Loss prevention managers are difficult to recruit. Consider candidates with combined store-operations and loss-prevention backgrounds, equip them with AI surveillance and data-analysis tools to reduce labor demands, and define advancement paths into regional loss prevention and supply-chain risk control to improve retention.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Alerts for refund and return fraud

ai_s7_trends: AI video and data analytics become standard loss-prevention tools, reducing manual screen monitoring.
Expansion in e-commerce warehousing and unmanned retail extends loss prevention into supply-chain risk control.
Loss prevention managers who understand data and lead teams become more sought after.

body: Loss prevention managers develop and execute shrinkage-control strategies for retail, warehousing, and logistics companies, manage video surveillance and anti-theft equipment, analyze inventory discrepancies and anomalous transactions, organize employee training, and address theft.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI video can monitor an entire store and data analytics can identify every vulnerability, but deciding whether to stop someone and how to intervene without causing harm still requires human judgment in the moment.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 视频能盯住整家店、数据分析能算出所有漏洞，但「这个人要不要拦、怎么拦才不出事」——临场的分寸，还得人拿捏。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年损失预防经理在岗约 133.37 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 139.35 万人，净增约 5.98 万个岗位，年均产生约 10.67 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 13.65 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代损失预防经理，但会重塑防损的执行层：AI 视频监控、异常交易识别、盘亏数据分析正在替代人工盯监控和事后查账，经理的角色从「看监控的人」变成「定策略的人」。真正稀缺的是判断案件性质、处理现场冲突、推动流程整改的能力。
ai_s2_accel: AI 识别惯犯与套现团伙
防盗设备联动云端预警
ai_s2_auto: AI 视频异常行为识别
库存盘亏数据自动分析
异常交易与退换货预警
ai_s3_list: 现场判断：要不要拦、怎么拦。
案件定性：内盗还是疏忽，轻重拿捏。
沟通分寸：跟员工、警方、顾客周旋。
流程整改：把漏洞从制度上堵死。
成本权衡：防损投入和产出的账。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明防损属于「中等 AI 曝光」的运营型岗位：监控识别、数据分析、报表生成都能被 AI 接管，执行层的防损员岗位会被压缩。但中高曝光不等于高风险——案件定性、现场处置、制度整改是 AI 替代不了的，经理的价值从「盯监控」转向「定策略、管好人」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着要主动升级：把 AI 视频和数据分析工具用熟，让系统帮你发现异常，你把精力放在案件处理和流程整改上。懂数据、会带团队的防损经理，在零售和电商仓储里会越来越吃香。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走防损管理的，建议学零售管理、物流或数据分析方向，再补一点安保与法律常识；先到零售企业从门店运营或防损专员做起，两年积累现场经验再转管理。
把 AI 视频监控和数据分析学起来，往区域防损或总部风控方向走；同时学点劳动法与取证知识，处理内盗案件更专业，晋升空间也更大。
有零售运营、安保管理、物流背景的转防损优势大；面试时强调你处理过损耗问题的具体案例和数据，比空谈「我有责任心」有用。
防损经理难招，建议接受「门店运营 + 防损」复合背景的人，配 AI 监控与数据分析工具降低人力负担；明确晋升到区域防损和供应链风控的通道，人才更愿意留。

ai_s7_trends: AI 视频与数据分析成为防损标配，人工盯监控减少。
电商仓储与无人零售扩张，防损向供应链风控延伸。
懂数据、会带团队的防损经理更吃香。

body: 损失预防经理负责制定和执行零售、仓储及物流企业的损耗控制策略，管理视频监控与防盗设备，分析库存盘亏与异常交易数据，组织员工防损培训，并处理偷盗。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 视频能盯住整家店、数据分析能算出所有漏洞，但「这个人要不要拦、怎么拦才不出事」——临场的分寸，还得人拿捏。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Devices can provide relaxation, but a therapist's hands still determine where the tension is, how much pressure to use, and how to read the client's condition.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 168,000 massage therapists were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 193,900 by 2034. That represents roughly 25,900 additional jobs and about 24,700 openings per year, with median annual pay of approximately $57,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace massage therapists, but it will divert mild needs. Massage chairs and relaxation devices accelerate routine relaxation, shifting people from basic massage toward assessment, customized techniques, rehabilitation support, and trust-based client relationships. Practitioners limited to standardized relaxation face the greatest pressure, while those who assess clients and support rehabilitation become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Tactile judgment: human hands provide the feel.
Pressure control: people judge intensity.
Body assessment: people read the body.
Rehabilitation support: people coordinate continuity.
Trust-based business: people sustain relationships.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 3/10 score means this occupation has low AI exposure. Hands-on techniques and touch are central, so systems cannot readily take over, though devices will gradually divert some demand.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not equal high risk. Standard relaxation activities face replacement, not customized assessment roles. Therapists who assess clients and support rehabilitation become scarcer as devices divert routine demand.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study anatomy and obtain certification. Basic massage is shrinking, so develop assessment and rehabilitation skills early.
Advance from hands-on techniques to assessment and rehabilitation support, then work toward lead-practitioner or trainer roles.
Highlight certification and examples demonstrating tactile skill. Employers value steady, attentive practitioners.
Do not assess candidates only on physical strength. Look for assessment and communication skills, and reward core staff who retain clients with commissions.

ai_s7_trends: Massage chairs divert mild demand.
Customized assessments receive greater recognition.
Therapists who support rehabilitation become more sought after.

body: Massage therapists use manual massage, pressure, and stretching to relieve muscle tension and pain. They assess physical condition, offer home-care guidance, and support relaxation and recovery.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Devices can provide relaxation, but a therapist's hands still determine where the tension is, how much pressure to use, and how to read the client's condition.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 设备能放松，但哪里紧、用什么力、客人状态怎么读，还是治疗师的手定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年按摩治疗师在岗约 16.80 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 19.39 万人，净增约 2.59 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.47 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.79 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会分流轻度需求。按摩椅与放松设备把常规放松提速，人从「基础推按」挪向「评估、定制手法、康复配合、信任经营」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准放松的，会评估、能配合康复的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 触感判断：手感靠人。
力道分寸：轻重靠人。
身体评估：读体靠人。
康复配合：衔接靠人。
信任经营：关系靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光——核心是手法与触感，系统暂时难接手，但设备会慢慢分流。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准放松」动作，不是「评估定制」的岗位。会评估、能配合康复的人，反而随分流更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学解剖与持证，纯推按在缩，早点练评估与康复。
从「手法」升级成「评估 + 康复配合」，争取主理或培训。
突出持证与手感案例，门店看重稳和细。
选人别只看力气，要看会不会评估和沟通，能留客的骨干值得给提成。

ai_s7_trends: 按摩椅分流轻度。
评估定制更被看重。
会康复配合更抢手。

body: 按摩治疗师通过手法推拿、按压与拉伸缓解肌肉紧张与疼痛，评估身体状态并给出居家照护建议，促进放松与恢复。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 设备能放松，但哪里紧、用什么力、客人状态怎么读，还是治疗师的手定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can diagnose faults remotely, but repair workers still decide how to dismantle and adjust equipment and how to eliminate hazards.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 28,400 mechanical door repairers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 31,700 by 2034. That represents roughly 3,300 additional jobs and about 2,700 openings per year, with median annual pay of approximately $51,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace mechanical door repairers, but it will reduce diagnostic work. Remote monitoring and prefabricated doors accelerate routine installation, shifting repairers from installing doors toward on-site disassembly, hazard elimination, and maintenance. Pure installation faces the greatest pressure, while people who understand mechanics and handle hazards remain more resilient.
ai_s3_list: On-site disassembly and installation: hands must remain steady.
Emergency hazard elimination: people safeguard safety.
Mechanism adjustment: people make the tradeoffs.
Complex faults: people provide judgment.
Customer communication: people coordinate the work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation in a moderately high-exposure area. Systems accelerate some activities, while human judgment and final responsibility remain essential.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Installing standard doors is the activity being replaced, not on-site disassembly and hazard elimination. Workers with strong mechanical skills who handle hazards become scarcer as productivity rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with electromechanical skills and practice disassembly and safety procedures. Pure installation is shrinking in the AI era, so develop hazard-elimination skills early.
Advance from installing doors toward repair and hazard elimination. Learn circuits and maintenance.
Highlight zero-incident performance and the service areas you covered. Property owners value stable and rapid work.
Do not assess candidates only on speed; examine safety and hands-on skills. Strong core workers deserve responsibility for a service area.

ai_s7_trends: Remote diagnosis becomes widespread, reducing installation work.
On-site hazard elimination creates opportunities.
Workers who perform emergency repairs remain more resilient.

body: Mechanical door repairers lead the installation and repair of door structures and operators. They coordinate faults, parts, and standards and use disassembly and adjustment techniques to restore operation and complete maintenance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can diagnose faults remotely, but repair workers still decide how to dismantle and adjust equipment and how to eliminate hazards.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能远程诊断，但怎么拆、怎么调、排险怎么处，还是维修工定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机械门维修工在岗约 2.84 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.17 万人，净增约 0.33 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.27 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.11 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代机械门维修工，但会压缩诊断。远程监测与预制门把常规安装提速，维修工从「装门」挪向「现场拆装、排险、保养」。真正被挤掉的是纯安装，懂机械、能排险的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 现场拆装：手要稳。
排险应急：安全靠人。
机构调试：取舍靠人。
复杂故障：判断靠人。
客户沟通：协调靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——部分环节被系统加速，但真正要人判断与兜底的地方还留着位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「装标准门」动作，不是「现场拆装与排险」的岗位。有机械力、能排险的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机电起步多练拆装和安全，AI 时代纯安装在缩，早点练排险。
从「装门」升级成「维修 + 排险」，学电路与保养。
突出零事故与片区，业主看重稳和快。
选人别只看快，看安全和动手，骨干值得给片区。

ai_s7_trends: 远程诊断普及，安装缩。
现场排险带来机会。
能抢修的工更稳。

body: 机械门维修工主导门体与门机的安装维修，统筹故障、配件与规范，运用拆装与调试手段，恢复开关并保养落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能远程诊断，但怎么拆、怎么调、排险怎么处，还是维修工定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can turn gene sequence alignments into reports, but scientists still have to work out why a microbe is drug-resistant.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 20,700 microbiologists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 21,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 900 jobs, with approximately 1,700 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $87,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace microbiologists, but it will speed up analysis. Once AI handles literature searches, sequence alignment, and experimental data organization, scientists can shift from processing data to setting research directions, explaining mechanisms, and making biosafety judgments. The truly scarce professionals are those who can design experiments, understand mechanisms, and translate results into practice.
ai_s2_accel: Large language model support for generating research hypotheses
Recommendations for experimental protocols and culture conditions
Rapid interpretation of antimicrobial susceptibility results
ai_s2_auto: Intelligent searches of literature and genomic databases
Automated sequence alignment and gene annotation
Automated cleaning and fitting of experimental data
Intelligent recognition of colonies and microscopy images
ai_s3_list: Experimental design: how to test a hypothesis.
Mechanistic judgment: why a microbe behaves this way.
Biosafety: firm boundaries for handling pathogens.
Interdisciplinary synthesis: integrating molecular biology, ecology, and clinical medicine.
Scientific judgment: which directions are worth pursuing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in a moderate-high exposure area for scientific data work. Search, alignment, and image recognition can all be accelerated, but experiments and biosafety remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces calculation and extraction, not thinking and judgment. Microbiologists who can set research directions, explain mechanisms, and safeguard biosafety will become scarcer. The greatest risk is to entry-level roles focused only on data labeling.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a strong foundation in biochemistry, and learn programming and omics early. In the AI era, success depends on understanding mechanisms and translating research into practice, not merely operating laboratory equipment.

Master AI sequence tools and knowledge graphs, and learn the basics of process development and pilot-scale production. Move from conducting experiments to advancing applications to create greater value.
Highlight which microorganisms you have worked with, what you have published, and how your work connects with industry. Molecular and culture-based results are especially valuable.
When hiring, assess depth of mechanistic understanding and biosafety expertise, not just publication counts. Senior experts who can lead applications deserve premium compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Vaccines and anti-infective drugs are driving R&D demand.
As AI-powered sequence and omics tools become widespread, entry-level search roles are shrinking.
Microbiology professionals with process development and pilot-scale production expertise are becoming scarcer.

body: Microbiologists study the structure, physiology, genetics, and ecology of microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, and fungi. Their work includes pathogen identification, fermentation and industrial microbiology, environmental microbial monitoring, and vaccine and drug development.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can turn gene sequence alignments into reports, but scientists still have to work out why a microbe is drug-resistant.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把基因序列比对成报告，但「这个菌为什么耐药」，还得科学家想明白。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年微生物学家在岗约 2.07 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.16 万人，净增约 0.09 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.73 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代微生物学家，但会加速分析。文献检索、序列比对和实验数据整理交给 AI 后，科学家从「跑数据」挪向「定方向、解机理、做生物安全判断」。真正稀缺的是能设计实验、看懂机理并把成果落地的人。
ai_s2_accel: 大模型辅助提出研究假设
实验方案与培养条件推荐
ai_s2_auto: 文献与基因数据库的智能检索
序列比对与基因注释自动化
实验数据的自动清洗与拟合
菌落与镜检图像的智能识别
ai_s3_list: 实验设计：怎么验证假设。
机理判断：菌为什么这样。
生物安全：病原操作红线。
跨学科综合：分子生态临床拧一起。
科学品味：什么方向值得追。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的科研数据区——检索、比对、图像识别都能被加速，但实验和生物安全仍留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「算和摘」，不是「想和判」。会定方向、解机理、守安全的微生物学家更稀缺。怕的是只做数据标注的初级岗。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 生物化学打底，早学编程与组学。AI 时代拼机理与落地，别只当实验操作员。
把 AI 序列工具和知识图谱用熟，补工艺与中试常识。从「做实验」升级成「推应用」，价值更高。
突出你做过什么菌、发过什么、和产业怎么对接。有分子与培养成果优先。
招人看机理深度和生物安全，不止看论文数。能带应用的资深专家值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 疫苗与抗感染药拉动研发需求。
AI 序列与组学普及，初级检索岗压缩。
会工艺与中试的复合微生物人更稀缺。

body: 微生物学家研究细菌、病毒、真菌等微生物的结构、生理、遗传与生态，开展病原鉴定、发酵与工业微生物、环境微生物监测以及疫苗与药物研发。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把基因序列比对成报告，但「这个菌为什么耐药」，还得科学家想明白。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can flag suspicious abnormal discharges in one second, but only a technologist can spot and correct electrodes placed incorrectly or all-channel artifacts caused by a patient turning over.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 178,800 technologists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 188,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 9,300 jobs, with roughly 13,600 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $48,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace neurodiagnostic technologists, but it will take over initial screening. AI-assisted waveform analysis, automatic annotation of abnormal discharges, and draft report generation free technologists from constant screen review. Electrode placement, artifact recognition, and real-time intraoperative judgment remain core human responsibilities that machines cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI artifact recognition and automatic filtering recommendations
Automatic event marking in long-term monitoring
AI-assisted alerts for intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring
Research applications in brain-computer interfaces and early neurological screening
ai_s2_auto: Automated waveform acquisition and baseline processing
AI automatically annotates suspected abnormal discharges
Automatic generation of draft reports and data archives
Software-assisted electrode positioning and lead configuration
ai_s3_list: Electrode placement and signal-quality control: AI cannot rescue data if the source is bad.
Artifact recognition: experience distinguishes real waveforms from interference caused by movement, eye motion, or muscle activity.
Real-time intraoperative judgment: no lapse in attention is acceptable when neurological function changes during surgery.
Patient reassurance and cooperation: technologists must stabilize patients during seizures, calm children, and work with critically ill patients.
Professional communication with physicians: explain key waveform findings clearly to support efficient diagnosis.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 reflects the large share of waveform interpretation and initial data screening in this occupation, tasks AI is rapidly taking over.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. AI can flag suspicious points but cannot determine whether an electrode is reliable or an artifact is interfering. Quality control is the human competitive advantage. Roles limited to running tests by procedure face pressure, while technologists skilled in quality control and intraoperative monitoring become scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Neurophysiology is a specialized medical-technology field with less competition than imaging and strong professional depth. Build a firm foundation in neuroanatomy and electrophysiology, gain extensive hands-on EEG/EMG experience during internships, and pursue certification early.

Use AI-assisted interpretation as a tool and invest the time saved in quality control and intraoperative monitoring. Specialize in long-term, sleep, or intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring, which command clear premiums and resist replacement.

People with nursing, imaging, or biomedical backgrounds have an advantage when transitioning. Train in the laboratory before certification, and quantify experience on your resume, such as independently completing XX EEG/EMG studies or monitoring XX surgeries.

Do not hire technologists based on credentials alone. On-site electrode placement and artifact handling reveal real capability. People who control quality, perform intraoperative monitoring, and accept responsibility for waveform quality deserve above-market pay.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Synchronized video and automatic event marking

ai_s7_trends: As AI interpretation spreads, technologists shift from screen watching toward quality control + intraoperative monitoring, increasing their on-site value.
Expansion of epilepsy centers, sleep centers, and intraoperative monitoring drives growth in specialized roles.
Accelerating brain-computer-interface and early neurological-screening research extends neurophysiology technology roles into research and frontier applications.

body: Neurodiagnostic technologists operate EEG, EMG, evoked-potential, and other neurophysiological equipment. They place electrodes, acquire signals, control quality, and support neurologists in diagnosis and intraoperative neurological monitoring.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can flag suspicious abnormal discharges in one second, but only a technologist can spot and correct electrodes placed incorrectly or all-channel artifacts caused by a patient turning over.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在一秒内标出可疑的异常放电，但电极贴歪了、病人翻了个身导致的全导伪迹，只有技术员能发现并补救。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年技术专家在岗约 17.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 18.81 万人，净增约 0.93 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.36 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.88 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代神经诊断技术专家，但会接管判读里的初筛活。AI 辅助波形分析、自动标注异常放电、报告初稿生成，正在把技术员从「盯屏判读」里解放出来。剩下的电极安放、伪迹识别、术中实时判断，是人的核心，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 伪迹识别与自动滤除建议
长程监测的自动事件标记
术中神经监测的 AI 辅助预警
脑机接口与神经早筛研究应用
ai_s2_auto: 波形采集与基线处理自动化
AI 自动标注疑似异常放电
报告初稿与数据归档自动生成
电极定位与导联设置软件辅助
ai_s3_list: 电极安放与信号质量把控：数据源头坏了，AI 也救不回来。
伪迹识别：病人一动、眼动、肌电混进来，能分清是波还是干扰，靠经验。
术中实时判断：手术台上神经功能变化，一刻不能走神。
病人安抚与配合：癫痫发作、儿童哭闹、重症病人，得有办法稳住。
与医生的专业沟通：把波形关键点讲清楚，帮诊断少走弯路。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业的波形判读、数据初筛比重较高，这些正被 AI 快速接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 能标出可疑点，却判断不了电极是否可靠、伪迹是否干扰——质量把控恰恰是人的护城河。真正被挤压的是「只会按流程跑检查」的岗位，会质控、能术中监测的技术员反而更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 神经电生理是医学技术里的细分赛道，竞争比影像小、专业性强。读相关专业时把神经解剖和电生理基础学扎实，实习时多上手 EEG/EMG，尽早考认证。
把 AI 辅助判读当工具，省下时间练质控和术中监测。往长程监测、睡眠监测、术中神经监测等专项发展，这些岗位溢价明显且不易被替代。
有护理、影像或生物医学背景者转型有优势。先入室受训再考证，简历里多写「独立完成过XX例脑电/肌电、术中监测过XX台手术」这类可量化经历。
招技术员别只看证书，现场贴电极、处理伪迹最能看出成色。会质控、能术中监测、敢对波形质量负责的人，值得高于市场价的薪资。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 视频同步与自动事件标记
干扰源定位与滤除建议

ai_s7_trends: AI 判读普及，技术员从「盯屏」转向「质控 + 术中监测」，现场价值提升。
癫痫中心、睡眠中心与术中监测需求扩张，专项岗位增长。
脑机接口与神经疾病早筛研究加速，神经电生理技术岗向科研与前沿延伸。

body: 神经诊断技术专家负责操作脑电图、肌电图、诱发电位等神经电生理设备，完成电极安放、信号采集与质量把控，并配合神经科医生进行诊断与术中神经功能监测。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能在一秒内标出可疑的异常放电，但电极贴歪了、病人翻了个身导致的全导伪迹，只有技术员能发现并补救。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically optimize drilling parameters, but when wellhead pressure suddenly changes, the driller's hands still need to react faster than thought.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 13,300 rotary drill operators, oil and gas, employed in 2024, projected to rise to 13,400 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 100 jobs, with roughly 1,200 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $65,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace oil and gas drill operators, but it will change how they operate. Automatic drilling, parameter optimization, and intelligent monitoring are spreading, shifting operators from drilling by feel toward monitoring data + managing automated systems. Well-control emergencies and comprehensive field judgment remain hardest to replace. When trouble develops downhole, AI cannot flag every event.
ai_s2_accel: AI optimization of drilling parameters and bit selection
Intelligent well-control monitoring and anomaly alerts
Real-time transmission of measurement-while-drilling data for decision support
ai_s2_auto: Automated recording and reporting of drilling parameters
ai_s3_list: Well-control emergency judgment: human reactions at the moment of abnormal pressure determine whether an accident occurs.
Drilling feel and experience: sensing formation hardness, binding, and bit bounce beyond machine data.
Crew coordination: well sites depend on teamwork and verbal commands that machines cannot replace.
Field repair ability: the drill floor cannot wait during equipment failures.
Safety discipline and responsibility: well-site rules were written through hard lessons from accidents.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score means part of this occupation operates through parameters and data. Automation and AI increasingly take over recording, monitoring, and optimization.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. Stronger automation increases demand for operators who understand systems and respond to emergencies. Purely manual, brute-force methods face pressure, while operators who interpret data and control wellheads become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study petroleum engineering or drilling technology and emphasize well-control and automation knowledge. As drilling automates in the AI era, operators who understand intelligent drilling and data analysis have stronger prospects.

Master automatic drilling and intelligent monitoring systems, moving from manual operation toward system management. Earn well-control certification, learn remote operation, and advance toward driller and new-technology roles.

People with mechanical or electromechanical backgrounds have an advantage when transitioning and can begin as roustabouts or drilling crew members. On your resume, specify the well types, equipment, and certifications you have worked with rather than simply claiming resilience.

When hiring operators, test well-control awareness + emergency response rather than strength alone. Operators who use automated systems and uphold safety discipline deserve higher pay and advancement paths.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Real-time transmission of inclination and weight on bit

ai_s7_trends: Automated drilling and AI parameter optimization spread, reducing purely manual operating roles.
Intelligent upgrades in well control and safety make emergency judgment and system management more valuable.
The industry fluctuates with the energy transition and expands into deepwater, shale, and new-energy drilling.

body: Oil and gas drill operators operate rotary rigs at petroleum and natural-gas well sites and control drilling, connect and replace tools, manage drilling-fluid circulation, and record parameters as key members of drilling crews.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can automatically optimize drilling parameters, but when wellhead pressure suddenly changes, the driller's hands still need to react faster than thought.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动优化钻进参数，但井口那一瞬间的压力突变，还得司钻的手比脑子快。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年油气旋转钻机操作员在岗约 1.33 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.34 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.12 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.50 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代油气钻机操作员，但会改变操作方式。自动送钻、参数优化和智能监控越来越多，操作员从「凭手感打井」升级到「盯数据 + 管自动系统」。真正难以替代的，是井控应急和现场综合判断——井底出事，AI 提醒不了每一次。
ai_s2_accel: AI 优化钻进参数与钻头选型
智能井控监测与异常预警
随钻测量数据实时回传辅助决策
ai_s2_auto: 钻进参数的自动记录与报表
自动送钻与参数控制系统
井史数据的电子化归档
ai_s3_list: 井控应急判断：压力异常那一刻，人的反应决定事故与否。
钻进手感与经验：地层软硬、憋跳钻，机器数据之外的感觉。
班组协同：井场是团队活，口令配合机器替代不了。
现场抢修能力：设备故障，钻台不能干等。
安全纪律与责任心：井场规矩是用事故换来的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一部分工作在参数和数据端——记录、监控、优化，这些正在被自动化和 AI 接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：自动化越强，越需要懂系统、会应急的操作员。被压缩的是纯手动、靠蛮力的作业方式，会看数据、能控井口的操作员反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读石油工程、钻井技术专业，重视井控和自动化知识。AI 时代钻井向自动化发展，懂智能钻井、会数据分析的操作员更有出路。
把自动送钻、智能监控这些系统学透，从「手动操作」升级到「系统管理」。考井控证、学远程操控，向司钻和新技术岗位发展。
有机械、机电背景的转型有优势，从场地工或钻工做起。简历上写「参与过什么井型、会什么设备、考过什么证」，比空谈吃苦有用。
招操作员要考「井控意识 + 应急反应」，别只看力气。会用自动化系统、守得住安全纪律的操作员，值得给更高待遇和晋升通道。

ai_s7_trends: 自动化钻井与 AI 参数优化普及，纯手动操作岗位减少。
井控与安全智能化升级，应急判断与系统管理更值钱。
行业随能源转型波动，向深水、页岩与新能源钻井延伸。

body: 油气钻机操作员在石油天然气钻井现场操作旋转钻机，负责钻进控制、钻具接换、泥浆循环与参数记录，是钻井队的关键操作岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动优化钻进参数，但井口那一瞬间的压力突变，还得司钻的手比脑子快。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can help interpret images and plan surgical paths, but when a child is on the operating table and the family waits outside, your hands and judgment are what matter.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,100 surgeons were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to remain at 1,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 0 jobs, with about 0 openings annually and a 2024 median annual salary of ≥$239,200 (highest BLS OES bracket, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace pediatric surgeons, but it will change how they work. AI is assisting with initial imaging review, preoperative planning, and medical-record writing, shifting physicians from experience-based interpretation toward AI assistance + surgical decisions. Machines cannot replace operative feel, intraoperative decisions, or communication with patients and families. Physicians who use AI effectively become more efficient.
ai_s2_accel: AI provides real-time intraoperative anatomical guidance
Maturing AI diagnostic models for neonatal imaging
Digital remote consultation and surgical instruction
ai_s2_auto: Automated collection of postoperative follow-up data
ai_s3_list: Operative feel and intraoperative decisions: people make real-time judgments when unexpected events occur.
Precise understanding of pediatric physiology: anesthesia and medications differ completely for a patient weighing only a few kilograms.
Patient and family communication: explain the condition, absorb anxiety, and build trust personally.
Emergency response: in neonatal emergencies, time is life.
Team leadership: the lead surgeon controls the pace and order in the operating room.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 means that AI participates in more than half of the supporting stages, including imaging interpretation and preoperative planning.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI assists with decision support, while people retain operation and responsibility. Judgment, procedures, and patient trust in the operating room become more important. Pure experience-based interpretation shrinks, while experienced physicians remain scarce.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Follow the clinical medicine path and commit to surgery despite its difficulty. Prioritize anatomy and surgical training; an internship at a children's specialty hospital is an advantage.
Use surgical robots and AI preoperative planning, and proactively pursue specialty training and complex cases. Advance from surgical proficiency to surgery + research + specialty leadership.

Physician career switching costs are high; changing fields requires repeating medical school and standardized residency training. Pediatric surgery has few entry windows, so consider general surgery or pediatrics residency before specializing.

When hiring pediatric surgeons, assess surgical volume and complex-case experience, not only title. Physicians who operate independently, lead teams, and communicate well with parents are the scarcest.

ai_s7_trends: As surgical robots, AI imaging, and 3D planning spread, physicians shift from experience-based interpretation toward AI assistance + surgical decisions, making technical literacy fundamental.
Pediatric healthcare decentralization and specialty development are accelerating. Pediatric surgeons remain in long-term shortage, making experienced talent more sought after.
Remote consultation and digital teaching extend pediatric specialty capabilities across regions and deepen clinical collaboration.

body: Pediatric surgeons diagnose and surgically treat childhood conditions, including congenital abnormalities, trauma, tumors, abdominal disorders, and other surgical diseases in neonates and children, conducting preoperative assessment, surgery, and postoperative management.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can help interpret images and plan surgical paths, but when a child is on the operating table and the family waits outside, your hands and judgment are what matter.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你判读影像、规划手术路径，但孩子躺在手术台上、家属在门外等着的那一刻，靠的是你的手和判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年外科医师在岗约 0.11 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.11 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.00 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代小儿外科医师，但会改变工作方式。影像初筛、术前规划、病历书写正被 AI 辅助，医师从「经验判读」转向「AI 辅助+手术决策」——手术台上的手感、术中决策和医患沟通，是机器替代不了的。会用 AI 的医师反而效率更高。
ai_s2_accel: 手术机器人辅助精细操作
AI 术中实时提示解剖结构
新生儿影像 AI 诊断模型成熟
远程会诊与手术示教数字化
ai_s2_auto: 影像初筛 AI 辅助判读
术后随访数据自动采集
ai_s3_list: 手术手感与术中决策：术中出现意外，临场判断靠人。
小儿生理的精细把握：几公斤的患儿，麻醉用药全不同。
医患沟通：把病情讲清、把焦虑接住，信任靠人建立。
突发急诊的处置：新生儿急症，时间就是生命。
团队领导：手术台上的节奏和秩序，主刀说了算。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有超过一半的辅助环节正被 AI 参与——影像判读、术前规划，AI 都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 辅助的是「决策支持」环节，留下的是「操作与责任」环节——手术台上的判断、操作和医患信任反而更重要。真正被压缩的是纯经验判读，成熟医师依然稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走临床医学路线，外科方向很苦但要坚定。重视解剖和手术实训，儿童专科医院实习经历是加分项。
把手术机器人、AI 术前规划用起来，主动参与专科进修和复杂病例。从「手术熟练」升级为「手术+科研+学科带头」。
医师职业转换成本高，跨行需重读医学院并完成规培。小儿外科窗口少，建议先走普外或儿科规培再专科化。
招小儿外科医师别只看职称，要看手术量与复杂病例经验。能独立主刀、会带团队、又擅长家长沟通的医师，是最稀缺的。

ai_s7_trends: 手术机器人、AI 影像与三维规划普及，医师从「经验判读」转向「AI 辅助+手术决策」，技术素养成为基本功。
儿童医疗资源下沉与专科建设加速，小儿外科医师长期短缺，成熟人才更抢手。
远程会诊与示教数字化，儿科专科能力可跨区域辐射，学科协作加深。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can calculate power flows, but dispatchers still decide which orders to issue and how to handle incidents.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 9,300 power distributors and dispatchers were employed in 2024, projected to fall to 9,000 by 2034, a net decrease of about 300 jobs, with about 800 openings annually and median annual pay of about $107,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace power dispatchers, but it will reduce routine adjustments. Automated dispatch and forecasting accelerate standard operations, shifting work from repeated adjustments toward incident assessment, emergency command, and safety oversight. Roles limited to routine adjustments face the greatest pressure, while people who exercise judgment and command operations become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Incident assessment: people make the tradeoffs.
Emergency command: people issue the orders.
Safety oversight: people accept responsibility.
Complex operations: people provide experience.
Cross-region coordination: people collaborate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 indicates that this occupation has moderately high AI exposure: adjustments and forecasting are accelerated, but judgment and command still leave a clear role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: routine adjustment tasks are replaced, not incident-command roles. People who exercise judgment and command operations become scarcer as renewable energy expands. Those who can only perform routine adjustments face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting in electrical work, build system and emergency-response skills. Pure adjustment work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop judgment early.
Advance from adjustment to judgment + command, and learn dispatch systems.
Highlight credentials and shift experience, and specify the grids you have supported.
Do not hire based only on steadiness. Look for incident-command ability. Strong performers deserve shift supervisor roles.

ai_s7_trends: Automated dispatch becomes widespread.
Renewable energy drives demand.
People who can command operations are in greater demand.

body: Power distributors and dispatchers monitor and regulate electric power system operations, control power flows and switches under instructions, handle abnormalities and incidents, and ensure grid safety, stability, and continuity of supply.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can calculate power flows, but dispatchers still decide which orders to issue and how to handle incidents.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能算潮流，但该下令、怎么处置事故，还是调度员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电力调度分配员调度员在岗约 0.93 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.90 万人，岗位净减约 0.03 万个，年均产生约 0.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.72 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代电力调度，但会压缩常规调节。自动调度与预测把标准操作提速，工作从「反复调」挪向「事故判断、应急指挥、安全把关」。真正被挤掉的是只做常规调节的人，会判断会指挥的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 事故判断：取舍靠人。
应急指挥：下令靠人。
安全把关：责任靠人。
复杂运行：经验靠人。
跨区协调：配合靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——调节与预测被加速，但判断与指挥还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「常规调节」动作，不是「事故指挥」的岗位。会判断会指挥的人，反而随新能源更稀缺。怕的是只会做常规调节。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 电气起步多练系统与应急，AI 时代纯调节在缩，早点练判断。
从「调节」升级成「判断 + 指挥」，学调度系统。
突出资质与值班，写清跟过哪些网。
选人别只看稳，要看会不会事故指挥。骨干值得给值班长。

ai_s7_trends: 自动调度普及。
新能源拉动需求。
会指挥的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can write news briefs, but people still decide which leads deserve pursuit, how to verify them, and how to judge events on the ground.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 49,300 news analysts, reporters, and journalists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 47,400 by 2034, a net loss of about 1,900 jobs, with about 4,100 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $60,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace reporters, but it will reduce demand for producing news briefs. Automated writing and aggregation absorb sports updates and short items, moving reporters from writing briefs toward investigation, verification, field reporting, and analysis. People who only republish press releases face displacement, while those with investigative skill and credibility become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Investigative reporting: people dig deeper.
On-site judgment: people understand circumstances.
Fact-checking: people resolve uncertainty.
Credibility: people build trust.
Trend analysis: people create the framework.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: AI exposure is relatively high. Aggregators are absorbing news briefs, but investigation and judgment still leave an essential role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces issuing press releases, not jobs that uncover the truth. As efficiency rises, people with investigative ability become even scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting in journalism, practice verification and writing. Pure news brief work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop investigative skills early.
Advance from writing briefs to conducting investigations + producing analysis, and build data and subject-matter expertise.
Highlight representative work and verification procedures, and specify the beats you have covered.
Do not evaluate candidates only by output volume; look for an investigative mindset and credibility.

ai_s7_trends: Aggregation is widespread, reducing news brief work.
Demand for in-depth and financial journalism is rising.
People with investigative skills are increasingly sought after.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能写快讯，但哪条值得追、怎么核、现场怎么判断，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年新闻分析师、记者与新闻工作者在岗约 4.93 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.74 万人，岗位净减约 0.19 万个，年均产生约 0.41 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.03 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代记者，但会压缩快讯产出。自动写稿与聚合吃赛事与简讯，记者从「写快讯」挪向「调查、核实、现场、解读」。真正被挤掉的是只发通稿的，有调查力与公信力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 调查报道：深挖靠人。
现场判断：处境靠人。
事实核查：存疑靠人。
公信力：信任靠人建。
解读趋势：框架靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: AI 曝光偏高——快讯被聚合吃，但调查与判断还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「发通稿」动作，不是「把真相查清楚」的岗位。有调查力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 新闻起步多练核查与写作，AI 时代纯快讯在缩，早点练调查。
从「写快讯」升级成「做调查 + 出解读」，学数据与领域。
突出代表作与核查流程，写清跑过哪些线。
选人别只看产量，要看有没有调查脑子和公信力。

ai_s7_trends: 聚合普及，快讯缩。
深度与财经需求升。
有调查力者更抢手。
